# Public-source code in libGLcore

Much of `libGLcore.so` is not board code. The software renderer, the display-list machinery, the pixel paths and the name tables descend from the OpenGL sample implementation that SGI published, which this repository carries as the `ogl-sample` submodule. This chapter gives each such routine of the 6.5.30m N32 library its own entry: what it does, the public source file that holds the same routine, and whether it reaches the board. The board-specific routines (the `kon` and `KONA` prefixes, and anything that stores to a board window) are in [libglcore-functions.md](libglcore-functions.md) and [opengl.md](opengl.md).

Public source: the sample implementation under `ogl-sample/gfx/lib/opengl`. Paths in the entries are relative to `ogl-sample`. The shipped source file of a routine is the heading it sits under, for example `so_names.c`; the sample file that holds the same routine is named in the entry.

Labels follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). An entry is **Established** only where the whole routine was read against the public body. **Inferred** entries are matched to the public routine by its name, its direct calls and its size, and were not read end to end. Where an entry says it differs from the public body, the difference was read in the disassembly. Each routine has an entry for the N32 library of the IP27 Kona build (`usr/gfx/arch/IP27KONA32`), which the IP35 copy repeats byte for byte. Where the 64-bit or original 32-bit build of the same routine makes the same number of calls and has a comparable size, it has its own entry at its own address, always inferred because only the N32 body was compared with the public source; those entries leave out routines whose description depends on structure offsets or sizes, which differ between the builds.

Direct calls that the disassembly labels with the name of a neighbouring symbol are calls to file-local routines.

## Software renderer (soft)

### so_accumop.c

- `Clear` in usr/gfx/arch/IP27KONA32/libGLcore.so: fills the clipped region of the accumulation buffer with the accumulation clear colour, each component scaled by the colour buffer and accumulation buffer scales, and it occupies 812 bytes at address 0x0d9baf10; the public sample-implementation source gfx/lib/opengl/glcore/s_accum.c holds the same routine, matched by name, no direct call in either, 1 indirect call, a shipped body of 49 source lines against 52 in the public file, and it makes no access to the board. Inferred.
- `Pick` in usr/gfx/arch/IP27KONA32/libGLcore.so: does nothing and returns, the accumulation buffer's procedure-pick hook for the 64-bit-cell buffer, and it occupies 8 bytes at address 0x0d9bb240; read in full against the public sample-implementation source gfx/lib/opengl/glcore/s_accum.c, identical in structure to the body, an empty function, and it makes no access to the board. Established.
- `Load` in usr/gfx/arch/IP27KONA32/libGLcore.so: reads the colour buffer through the clip rectangle in chunks and stores each pixel, scaled by the argument value, into the accumulation buffer, taking the buffer lock for the read and accumulation buffers, and it occupies 1084 bytes at address 0x0d9b9da0; the public sample-implementation source gfx/lib/opengl/glcore/s_accum.c holds the same routine, matched by name, no direct call in either, 1 indirect call, a shipped body of 68 source lines against 76 in the public file, and it makes no access to the board. Inferred.
- `Accumulate` in usr/gfx/arch/IP27KONA32/libGLcore.so: reads the colour buffer through the clip rectangle in chunks and adds each pixel, scaled by the argument value, to the accumulation buffer, and it occupies 1304 bytes at address 0x0d9ba1e0; the public sample-implementation source gfx/lib/opengl/glcore/s_accum.c holds the same routine, matched by name, no direct call in either, 1 indirect call, a shipped body of 68 source lines against 76 in the public file, and it makes no access to the board. Inferred.
- `Mult` in usr/gfx/arch/IP27KONA32/libGLcore.so: multiplies every accumulation cell inside the clip rectangle by the argument value, taking the accumulation buffer lock, and it occupies 1092 bytes at address 0x0d9ba700; the public sample-implementation source gfx/lib/opengl/glcore/s_accum.c holds the same routine, matched by name, no direct call in either, a shipped body of 60 source lines against 72 in the public file, and it makes no access to the board. Inferred.
- `Add` in usr/gfx/arch/IP27KONA32/libGLcore.so: adds the argument value, scaled to cell units, to every accumulation cell inside the clip rectangle, and it occupies 556 bytes at address 0x0d9bab50; the public sample-implementation source gfx/lib/opengl/glcore/s_accum.c holds the same routine, matched by name, no direct call in either, a shipped body of 41 source lines against 51 in the public file, and it makes no access to the board. Inferred.
- `Return` in usr/gfx/arch/IP27KONA32/libGLcore.so: writes the accumulation buffer back into the colour buffer, scaling each cell by the argument value and clamping it, once per colour buffer that is drawn, and it occupies 396 bytes at address 0x0d9bad80; the public sample-implementation source gfx/lib/opengl/glcore/s_accum.c holds the same routine, matched by name, no direct call in either, 3 indirect calls, a shipped body of 32 source lines against 42 in the public file, and it makes no access to the board. Inferred.
- `__glInitAccum64` in usr/gfx/arch/IP27KONA32/libGLcore.so: sets up the accumulation buffer with 64-bit cells: it initialises the base buffer and installs the pick, clear, accumulate, load, return, multiply and add procedures, then derives the colour scales for RGB contexts, and it occupies 280 bytes at address 0x0d9bb250; the public sample-implementation source gfx/lib/opengl/glcore/s_accum.c holds the same routine, matched by name, the same direct call to `__glInitBuffer`, a shipped body of 34 source lines against 30 in the public file, and it makes no access to the board.
